body.heading: Make your dice
paragraphs: An adult helps you fold paper into two big cubes. On one, draw who is in the story: a cat, a pirate, a robot.
On the other dice, draw where they are: a castle, a boat, a forest. Keep the pictures big and simple.

body.heading: Roll and tell
paragraphs: Roll both dice. Start your story with the picture pair you rolled: Once, a robot sailed on a boat...
Take turns rolling and adding one part each. The story can be as silly as you like.

takeaway: A roll of the dice can start a story that nobody has ever told before.
safetyNotes: An adult helps fold and tape the dice so they stay strong.
screenFreeExtension: Tell the story again at bedtime and change the ending.
